title: A Letter About a Job
text:
Dear Mr. Silva, I am writing to ask about the job advertised on your website. I have three years of experience in sales. Please find my CV attached.

I am available for an interview any day next week. Thank you for your time. I look forward to hearing from you.

questions.text: Why is the writer writing the letter?
options: To invite a friend to dinner

questions.text: How many years of experience does the writer have?
Why does the writer attach a CV?
options: To show her qualifications for the job

questions.text: How does the writer probably feel about the job?

vocabulary.definition: knowledge or skill gained from doing a job or activity over time
free and able to do something at a certain time
a meeting where someone asks questions to decide if they will hire you
sent with an email or letter

paragraph_translations: Prezado Sr. Silva, estou escrevendo para perguntar sobre a vaga anunciada no seu site. Tenho três anos de experiência em vendas. Por favor, encontre meu currículo em anexo.
Estou disponível para uma entrevista em qualquer dia da próxima semana. Agradeço pelo seu tempo. Aguardo seu retorno.
